commentary.text: 90+10' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+8' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 3:6.
90+5' A substitution has been made. Maximilian Eggestein is replaced by Florent Muslija (Freiburg).
90+5' Ralph Hasenhuttl has decided to substitute Jonas Wind and he is replaced by Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg).
90+4' Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) earns the yellow card.
90+2' Frank Willenborg shows a yellow card to Lucas Holer (Freiburg) for his blatant foul.
90+1' Substitution. Christian Gunter makes way for Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg).
90' 8 additional min. will be played.

90' 1 - 2 Maxence Lacroix (Wolfsburg) scores one of the best goals in his career. His rocket of a shot from distance goes straight into the top right corner. They will be showing this on every football show for some time to come.
87' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) doesn't keep his cool and fails to convert the penalty. He skies the ball way over the bar and into the stands.
87' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) is going to take the penalty!
87' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Freiburg!
86' Referee Frank Willenborg makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Freiburg. Let’s see what happens!
85' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
84' Koen Casteels (Wolfsburg) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee decides to stop play.
82' 1 - 1 Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) produces an astonishing free kick which slams into the top right corner off the post and gives the goalkeeper no chance.
81' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
80' The attendance is 32800.
78' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
77' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) whips in a cross from the corner, but Noah Atubolu is well positioned and punches the ball away.
75' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
73' Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Frank Willenborg had an easy-decision to make.
72' Christian Streich prepares a substitution. Michael Gregoritsch is replaced by Lucas Holer (Freiburg).
72' Christian Streich decides to make a substitution. Vincenzo Grifo will be replaced by Jordy Makengo (Freiburg).
72' The corner is swung in but Wolfsburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
69' Substitution. Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) replaces Aster Vranckx.
69' Looks like Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
67' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
64' Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) makes a horrible challenge on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
62' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) was quite harsh and Frank Willenborg didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
59' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Freiburg.
57' Wolfsburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
55' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) is given a yellow card.
53' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg).
50' Wolfsburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

48' The resulting set piece from Wolfsburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. Wolfsburg have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
46' The game is over for Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg). Joakim Maehle comes on for the second half.
46' Ralph Hasenhuttl makes a switch. Kevin Paredes is coming on in place of Cedric Zesiger (Wolfsburg) at the start of the second period.
46' Ralph Hasenhuttl makes a half-time substitution. Patrick Wimmer comes on in place of Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg).
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' The current number of shots on goal is 2:1.
42' 1 - 0 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it into the bottom right corner of his own goal.
40' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
38' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
36' Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
35' Freiburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
34' Good movement by Ritsu Doan (Freiburg), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
31' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
29' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
27' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
25' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
21' A clever short pass gives Roland Sallai (Freiburg) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar.
20' Manuel Gulde (Freiburg) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
18' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
16' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
13' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Frank Willenborg blows for a foul.
12' Freiburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
9' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the left post.
7' Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
6' Crossbar! Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) throws the chance away as he attempts to produce a shot from inside the box, but his attempt only rattles the crossbar! The goalkeeper can remain calm.
5' The ball is cleared after Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
3' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
